_about: The Godtree as a far backdrop for the sandbox sky (pillar 2: the Godtree is always ahead). Cut out with BiRefNet and shown on a distant card.

subjects.subject: One impossibly colossal ancient tree seen from very far away, alone and centred, the whole tree in frame from its spreading roots to the top of its crown, a pale cream bark trunk as wide as a mountain, a vast layered soft green crown rising above a ring of small white clouds, the whole tree softened and tinted pale blue by distance haze, against a plain flat empty light blue sky, no ground, no horizon, no other trees, no people.
